items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: Ted Lewis had one like it except Ted's cost a lot more money, I'm sure.

ctx.x: He, the Conn factory had made him up a gold saxophone with rubies and diamonds and everything on the inside of the bell and on the outside. One of the fanciest things. Ted Lewis had one like it except Ted's cost a lot more money, I'm sure. But Conn made this up for Ham Crawford. And, uh, he used to put a light, had a little light hooked up with batteries and he would, uh, on waltzes he would go around the floor. Band would stay in the background. He would get out and mingle with all the people, uh, waltzing. And,…
What about, uh, was Rudy Weidoff popular then?
